title: Home Assistant terminology for civica authors
scope: A complete mapping of the specified source inventories, with original household explanations. This is not every string in every Home Assistant translation, integration, vendor product or future release.

normative_basis.meaning: This dated supplement applies the frozen writing rules; it introduces no replacement labels, new MUST rules or unreviewed translations.

inventories.title: Official glossary entries
inventories.exclusions: The linked glossary has 72 Home Assistant concepts and 11 data/template types; integration-specific and future vocabulary is not implied.

inventories.title: Core entity platforms
inventories.exclusions: This is the generated entity-platform enum, not every integration directory, helper domain, device class or vendor capability.

inventories.exclusions: Deliberately scoped authored terminology; not every string, action parameter, integration or translation.

inventories.title: Named scalar/helper types in the frontend picker
inventories.exclusions: Other helper integrations and calculations are available; these nine are the named scalar/helper types in this translation subtree.

inventories.title: Settings dashboard destination names
inventories.exclusions: Availability depends on installation, integrations, permissions and version. The cloud record has no main label in this subtree; it is not silently counted as a missing string.

inventories.title: Card dispatch identifiers
inventories.exclusions: Includes internal, strategy, error and legacy dispatch keys. This denominator is not a count of public cards or maintained civica adapters.

inventories.title: Card-feature identifiers
inventories.exclusions: Feature availability is conditional on the card, entity and integration; this is not a promise that every feature is installed in civica.

inventories.title: Frontend selector dispatch identifiers
inventories.exclusions: The registry includes internal and compatibility selectors. The publicly documented blueprint selector subset is a separate catalogue; this list does not make internal schemas public APIs.

inventories.title: Native view layouts
inventories.exclusions: Custom views and future layout types are outside this pinned registry.

inventories.title: Additional state domains in native row/dialog registries
inventories.exclusions: All 15 additional-state-domain IDs in the independent native interface census; reused glossary/helper entries are not new terms. Neither inventory is the entire integration catalogue.

inventories.title: Other documented domains needed by existing guide topics
inventories.exclusions: Plant corresponds to the public Plant status card; Zone and Schedule are already used by household guide topics. These 3 are not claimed to be members of the 15-key row/dialog census. Neither inventory is the entire integration catalogue.

inventories.title: Configuration keys and values
inventories.coverage: Every snake_case key or value written in code on the component pages, each checked to exist in the pinned frontend source.
exclusions: Names that belong to Civica or to third-party integrations, not to Home Assistant.

terms.household_wording: Name the operation. Do not call it a “service”.
terms.first_use_explanation: An action asks Home Assistant to carry out an operation.
terms.avoid_confusion: Accepting the request does not prove the device finished it.

terms.household_wording: Use the device’s own control name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that can respond to a control request.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is a technical role, not a household member.

terms.household_wording: Write “app”. Add “previously add-on” once when reading older instructions.
terms.first_use_explanation: Software that runs alongside Home Assistant on Home Assistant OS.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not an integration, a dashboard card or the phone’s Companion app.

terms.household_wording: Use the name the household gave it.
terms.first_use_explanation: A room or other space that groups devices and entities.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not a zone, and an action on an area can affect several entities.

terms.household_wording: Say what starts it and what it does.
terms.first_use_explanation: A set of actions that runs when a trigger happens and its conditions are met.
terms.avoid_confusion: Saved, turned on and triggered are separate facts.
terms.code_kind: entity/integration domain; preserve exact spelling

terms.household_wording: Say what the backup contains.
terms.first_use_explanation: A saved copy that can be used to restore or move a setup.
terms.avoid_confusion: Creating one does not prove a restore works or that outside services are included.

terms.household_wording: Use the meaning, such as “Door” or “Motion”.
terms.first_use_explanation: A sensor that reports one of two states, such as open or closed.
terms.avoid_confusion: Raw “on” can mean open, detected or low, not electrical power.

terms.household_wording: Write “blueprint”, and say whether it is for an automation or a script.
terms.first_use_explanation: A reusable definition used to create an automation or script.
terms.avoid_confusion: Choosing inputs or saving does not prove it has run.

terms.household_wording: Name the request.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that makes one request when pressed.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not a switch, and its last-pressed time does not prove completion.

terms.household_wording: Write “calendar” and its name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that supplies events and their times.
terms.avoid_confusion: An event on a calendar is not an automation run.

terms.household_wording: Say which table it belongs to.
terms.first_use_explanation: A way to organise entries within one table, such as automations.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not a label, an area or a permission.

terms.household_wording: Use the control’s own name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity for heating or cooling, with a target and a mode.
terms.avoid_confusion: A selected Heat mode is not the same as currently heating.

terms.household_wording: Name the task that works without the cloud.
terms.first_use_explanation: Working without a remote vendor service.
terms.avoid_confusion: One integration working locally does not make the whole setup local.

terms.household_wording: Write “add the device” or “set up the device”.
terms.first_use_explanation: Joining a Matter device to a controller.
terms.avoid_confusion: Discovering a device is not commissioning it.

terms.household_wording: Write “integration”. Keep literal paths that contain “components”.
terms.first_use_explanation: An older name for an integration.
terms.avoid_confusion: A civica component is a different thing.

terms.household_wording: Say what must be true.
terms.first_use_explanation: A check that decides whether a run may continue.
terms.avoid_confusion: It does not start a run or wait for something to become true.

terms.household_wording: Name the file, usually `configuration.yaml`. Do not suggest every setting needs one.
terms.first_use_explanation: A file that stores settings Home Assistant reads.
terms.avoid_confusion: Saving a file is not the same as checking it, reloading it or restarting.

terms.household_wording: Use the cover’s own name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity for a blind, door, gate or curtain.
terms.avoid_confusion: A position value is specific to the integration and is not a safety check.

terms.household_wording: Name its provider.
terms.first_use_explanation: An integration added from outside the ones Home Assistant bundles.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not official and may not be supported like Core.

terms.household_wording: Say what changes.
terms.first_use_explanation: Overriding a setting or how something is shown.
terms.avoid_confusion: Renaming a label does not change an entity ID or what a device can do.

terms.household_wording: Use the name the household gave it.
terms.first_use_explanation: A group of related entities for one product or service.
terms.avoid_confusion: One device can have many entities, and not every entity belongs to a device.

terms.household_wording: Write “tracker” and its source.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that reports a place or presence from an integration.
terms.avoid_confusion: It does not prove a person is present, available or safe.

terms.household_wording: Name the integration. Tell people to check the file before sharing.
terms.first_use_explanation: Technical information that helps investigate a problem.
terms.avoid_confusion: It does not repair anything and may include private details.

terms.household_wording: Say “found”, not “added”.
terms.first_use_explanation: Finding a device or service that may be ready to set up.
terms.avoid_confusion: Found is not configured, allowed or ready to control.

terms.household_wording: Say what you mean: entity family or action namespace.
terms.first_use_explanation: The first part of an entity ID, or the namespace of an action.
terms.avoid_confusion: It can differ from the integration that provides it, and it is not an internet domain.

terms.household_wording: Say “light”, “sensor” or “switch” where you can.
terms.first_use_explanation: One reading, control or function in Home Assistant.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not always a physical device, and its state may be assumed or unavailable.

terms.household_wording: Say what was reported.
terms.first_use_explanation: A message that something happened in Home Assistant.
terms.avoid_confusion: Receiving one does not confirm a physical result.

terms.household_wording: Write “event” and its type.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that shows the latest event reported.
terms.avoid_confusion: Its time is not a running state, and no recent event does not mean nothing happened.

terms.household_wording: Use the household’s name for it.
terms.first_use_explanation: A group of areas on one level.
terms.avoid_confusion: Do not infer a building layout or where someone is.

terms.household_wording: Write “Home Assistant”.
terms.first_use_explanation: The browser interface that shows data and sends requests.
terms.avoid_confusion: Refreshing the browser does not restart Core, the host or a device.

terms.household_wording: Name the members.
terms.first_use_explanation: A set of entities that share a state or an action.
terms.avoid_confusion: Group rules vary. A result must not drop unknown or unavailable members.
terms.code_kind: entity/integration domain; preserve exact spelling

terms.household_wording: Say what value or calculation it gives.
terms.first_use_explanation: A stored value, calculation or other building block.
terms.avoid_confusion: Creating or changing one can trigger automations that depend on it.

terms.household_wording: Write “Home Assistant”. Keep it in exact commands and names.
terms.first_use_explanation: A historical abbreviation for Home Assistant.
terms.avoid_confusion: Do not introduce it in new writing.

terms.household_wording: Write “Home Assistant OS”. Keep it in exact identifiers.
terms.first_use_explanation: An older name for Home Assistant Operating System.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not Core or the Supervisor.

terms.household_wording: Write “Home Assistant Container”.
terms.first_use_explanation: Home Assistant running in a container on a system the installer manages.
terms.avoid_confusion: It has no app store, so OS-only steps do not apply.

terms.household_wording: Say whether you mean the software or the install method.
terms.first_use_explanation: The main Home Assistant program.
terms.avoid_confusion: The program is current. The old standalone Core installation method is deprecated.

terms.household_wording: Use it only for older instructions.
terms.first_use_explanation: A deprecated install method that ran the Supervisor on a separately managed host.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not recommended for new setups, and it is not the Supervisor on OS.

terms.household_wording: Write “Supervisor” only when diagnosing.
terms.first_use_explanation: The part of Home Assistant OS that manages apps and the system.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not an administrator account or a person.

terms.household_wording: Write the full name once, then “Home Assistant OS”.
terms.first_use_explanation: The maintained operating system for running Home Assistant.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not the browser interface, Core or a phone’s system.

terms.household_wording: Name the machine.
terms.first_use_explanation: The computer or system that runs the software.
terms.avoid_confusion: Restarting it affects more than refreshing a browser or restarting Core.

terms.household_wording: Give the subject and the time.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that supplies a still picture.
terms.avoid_confusion: A stored image is not live video, and an old frame is not current.

terms.household_wording: Write “integration” and its name.
terms.first_use_explanation: The connection between Home Assistant and a device family or service.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not an app or a card, and it does not prove local-only control.

terms.household_wording: Say what Assist understood.
terms.first_use_explanation: The task Assist understood from what was said.
terms.avoid_confusion: A recognised intent does not prove permission or that it ran.

terms.household_wording: Show the exact label.
terms.first_use_explanation: A tag for organising or targeting supported items.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not a room, a category or a security boundary.

terms.household_wording: Write “dashboard”. Keep literal `lovelace` keys and routes.
terms.first_use_explanation: The historical name for Home Assistant dashboards.
terms.avoid_confusion: It remains in technical paths and configuration keys.

terms.household_wording: Use the light’s own name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that turns a light on or off and may dim it or change colour.
terms.avoid_confusion: Not every light dims or changes colour, and off is not electrical isolation.

terms.household_wording: Name the operation that is local.
terms.first_use_explanation: Control over the local network without a vendor cloud.
terms.avoid_confusion: It does not prove that setup, updates or remote access are also local.

terms.household_wording: Explain the standard on first use.
terms.first_use_explanation: A smart-home standard supported by compatible controllers and devices.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not a radio type. A Matter device can use Thread or wifi.

terms.household_wording: Say where it goes.
terms.first_use_explanation: A message sent through a supported channel.
terms.avoid_confusion: Sent, delivered, seen and acknowledged are different, and a notification is not an alarm.

terms.household_wording: Write “configuration package” in YAML guidance.
terms.first_use_explanation: A way to group related configuration in YAML.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not an app, a software dependency or a downloaded theme.

terms.household_wording: Write “platform” only in integration documentation.
terms.first_use_explanation: A kind of entity an integration can provide.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not another word for the host, a cloud service or Home Assistant itself.

terms.household_wording: Say how often Home Assistant asks.
terms.first_use_explanation: Asking a source for an update again and again.
terms.avoid_confusion: A shorter interval does not guarantee fresh data and may overload the source.

terms.household_wording: Name what is reloaded.
terms.first_use_explanation: Asking part of Home Assistant to read its configuration again.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not a restart, and not every YAML change can apply without one.

terms.household_wording: Say which states it requests.
terms.first_use_explanation: A saved set of entity states requested together.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not a timed routine, and activating one does not prove every member changed.

terms.household_wording: Say what sequence it runs.
terms.first_use_explanation: A sequence of actions started on request or by another operation.
terms.avoid_confusion: Saving does not run it, and stopping does not undo requests already sent.
terms.code_kind: entity/integration domain; preserve exact spelling

terms.household_wording: Name the quantity and use the supplied name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that reports a measurement or other value.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not necessarily hardware. Keep units, missing values and times.

terms.household_wording: Describe the choice, such as “Choose an entity”.
terms.first_use_explanation: The kind of input a configuration field accepts.
terms.avoid_confusion: It limits an answer. It does not grant access or prove capability.

terms.household_wording: Say “action” for an operation.
terms.first_use_explanation: In the official glossary, a source of entities that is not a physical product.
terms.avoid_confusion: Older instructions also used “service” for what is now an action.

terms.household_wording: Say what was reported, with its source.
terms.first_use_explanation: The value Home Assistant holds for an entity.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not necessarily fresh, verified or what was asked for.

terms.household_wording: Write “state record” in a technical step.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity’s value, attributes, times and context together.
terms.avoid_confusion: It does not hold every setting or show who caused a change.

terms.household_wording: Use the supplied name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that turns something on and off and reports its state.
terms.avoid_confusion: A helper toggle and a physical switch are different, and off is not safe isolation.

terms.household_wording: Say what value it calculates.
terms.first_use_explanation: A calculation or format written in template syntax.
terms.avoid_confusion: A result is not a measured value. Missing input must not become zero.

terms.household_wording: Write “Thread network”.
terms.first_use_explanation: A low-power mesh network used by compatible devices.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not Matter, and a Thread device may not be commissioned.

terms.household_wording: Explain its role.
terms.first_use_explanation: A device that joins a Thread network to the local network.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not necessarily the Home Assistant host or a Matter controller.

terms.household_wording: Say what starts it.
terms.first_use_explanation: The event or change that starts an automation.
terms.avoid_confusion: Saving or turning on an automation is not the trigger.

terms.household_wording: Write “text-to-speech (TTS)” once.
terms.first_use_explanation: Text turned into spoken audio.
terms.avoid_confusion: Making audio does not prove a speaker played it. Privacy depends on the provider.

terms.household_wording: Say whether it is downloading, installing, restarting or done.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that reports a software release and may offer to install it.
terms.avoid_confusion: A notice is not an installation.

terms.household_wording: Use the valve’s own name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity for a valve that opens, closes or sets a position.
terms.avoid_confusion: A closed state is not proof of isolation or zero flow.

terms.household_wording: Say where it is used.
terms.first_use_explanation: Named values that later steps can use.
terms.avoid_confusion: A variable in a run is not a saved helper and does not survive a restart.

terms.household_wording: Write “YAML”, and say that spacing matters.
terms.first_use_explanation: The text format for supported configuration files.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not prose. Spacing, keys, quotes and identifiers must be exact.

terms.household_wording: Use its geographic name.
terms.first_use_explanation: A named geographic place used by location features.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not an indoor area or floor, and it does not prove who is there.
terms.code_kind: entity/integration domain; preserve exact spelling

terms.household_wording: Name the quantity.
terms.first_use_explanation: Stored summaries of supported sensors over set periods.
terms.avoid_confusion: They are not the original history, and units and state class affect how to read them.

terms.household_wording: Write “true or false value”.
terms.first_use_explanation: A value that is either true or false.
terms.avoid_confusion: The text “false” is not always the same as the value false.

terms.household_wording: Write “decimal number”.
terms.first_use_explanation: A number that can have a fractional part.
terms.avoid_confusion: A conversion can fail. Do not turn a missing reading into zero.

terms.household_wording: Write “whole number”.
terms.first_use_explanation: A whole number with no fractional part.
terms.avoid_confusion: Converting a reading to one can lose precision.

terms.household_wording: Write “text value”.
terms.first_use_explanation: A text value.
terms.avoid_confusion: A state is text, so arithmetic needs a conversion.

terms.household_wording: Write “list”.
terms.first_use_explanation: An ordered set of values.
terms.avoid_confusion: A list of targets is not one entity, and an empty list is not an unavailable reading.

terms.household_wording: Write “values to loop through”.
terms.first_use_explanation: A set of values a template can loop through.
terms.avoid_confusion: Some can be read only once. Convert to a list to reuse it.

terms.household_wording: Write “date and time”.
terms.first_use_explanation: A value with a date and a time.
terms.avoid_confusion: A date alone and a time without a time zone are different values.

terms.household_wording: Copy it exactly in a definition. Do not use it in household writing.
terms.first_use_explanation: An input or result that is not limited to one value type.
terms.avoid_confusion: It does not mean every value works for every operation.

terms.household_wording: Copy the name and arguments exactly.
terms.first_use_explanation: A named call with arguments in brackets.
terms.avoid_confusion: Its syntax is not a filter’s or a test’s.

terms.household_wording: Write “template filter”.
terms.first_use_explanation: A step that changes a value passed to it with the pipe symbol.
terms.avoid_confusion: It can change the type or drop values.

terms.household_wording: Write “template test”.
terms.first_use_explanation: A check using “is” that gives true or false.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not an automated software test.

terms.household_wording: Name the task.
terms.first_use_explanation: A request to an AI provider to produce a result from supplied input.
terms.avoid_confusion: The output is not a verified measurement and does not show a physical task ran.

terms.household_wording: Name the quantity measured.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that reports the air measurements its source supports.
terms.avoid_confusion: Do not invent a health rating or convert an index into a concentration.

terms.household_wording: Use the alarm’s own name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that shows alarm modes and takes arm and disarm requests.
terms.avoid_confusion: Armed, arming, pending and triggered are different, and the display is not independent confirmation.

terms.household_wording: Name the voice device.
terms.first_use_explanation: A voice device that listens and plays back for Assist.
terms.avoid_confusion: Opening a page does not start recording, and satellites differ.

terms.household_wording: Name the condition detected.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity whose device class turns raw on and off into meaningful states.
terms.avoid_confusion: Raw “on” can mean low battery, open or detected.

terms.household_wording: Name the request.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that makes one request when pressed.
terms.avoid_confusion: It has no lasting state, and a press time does not confirm the result.

terms.household_wording: Write “calendar” and its name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that supplies scheduled events.
terms.avoid_confusion: An active event does not prove that something happened at home.

terms.household_wording: Use the camera’s name and give the time of an image.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that supplies pictures or streams.
terms.avoid_confusion: Do not promise live video, sound or recording the integration cannot give.

terms.household_wording: Use the control’s own name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that shows targets, modes and readings for heating or cooling.
terms.avoid_confusion: Current action, selected mode and target are different.

terms.household_wording: Write “conversation agent”.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that handles text requests with its agent.
terms.avoid_confusion: A reply may not have done anything or used only local processing.

terms.household_wording: Use the cover’s own name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity for a movable opening or shade.
terms.avoid_confusion: Controls and position vary. Do not assume stop or tilt works.

terms.household_wording: Write “date” and its purpose.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that holds a date.
terms.avoid_confusion: It has no time of day and does not repeat.

terms.household_wording: Write “date and time” and its purpose.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that holds a date and a time.
terms.avoid_confusion: Give the time zone. Do not swap in a date-only or time-only helper.

terms.household_wording: Write “tracker” and its source.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that reports a detected place or presence.
terms.avoid_confusion: A missing update does not prove absence, and a device is not its owner.

terms.household_wording: Name the event.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that records the latest event from its integration.
terms.avoid_confusion: Its time is not a lasting on or off condition.

terms.household_wording: Use the fan’s own name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity with the speed, direction, oscillation or preset controls the fan supports.
terms.avoid_confusion: Not every fan has all of them or the same speed scale.

terms.household_wording: Name the source.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity for a point or event from a location source.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not a person’s tracker.

terms.household_wording: Name it as the source does.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity for humidity control settings and readings.
terms.avoid_confusion: The target is not the measured humidity, and it may dehumidify.

terms.household_wording: Give the subject and the time.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that supplies a still picture.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not video, and its contents are not current without a time.

terms.household_wording: Name the analysis.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that shows results from an analysis of pictures.
terms.avoid_confusion: A detection is an interpretation, and no detection does not prove absence.

terms.household_wording: Name the device and the command.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that sends infrared commands.
terms.avoid_confusion: Sending does not prove the appliance received it, and infrared reports no state.
terms.native_name_kind: official technical term; no title in this strings file

terms.household_wording: Use the mower’s own name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity for a mower’s activity and controls.
terms.avoid_confusion: Do not assume Start, Pause or Dock exists, or treat the state as a safety check.

terms.household_wording: Use the light’s own name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity for a light’s controls and reported state.
terms.avoid_confusion: Do not offer colour or brightness for a light that only turns on and off.

terms.household_wording: Use the lock’s own name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that reports a lock’s state and takes lock requests.
terms.avoid_confusion: Unlock and Open can differ, and the state is not proof of security.

terms.household_wording: Use the player’s own name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity for playback, volume and source controls.
terms.avoid_confusion: Stop, Pause, Mute and Turn off differ, and what is available depends on the player.

terms.household_wording: Name the destination.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that is a place to send messages.
terms.avoid_confusion: A successful send does not prove delivery or that it was read.

terms.household_wording: Name the quantity set.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that holds a number with a range and a step.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not a Number helper. Keep its unit and meaning.

terms.household_wording: Name the device and the command.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that sends radio commands.
terms.avoid_confusion: Transmitting does not prove receipt.
terms.native_name_kind: official technical term; no title in this strings file

terms.household_wording: Use the remote’s own name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that sends commands to another device.
terms.avoid_confusion: A sent command does not confirm a change. Do not invent command names.

terms.household_wording: Use the scene’s own name.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that requests a saved set of states.
terms.avoid_confusion: It has no lasting “on” state and does not verify every member.

terms.household_wording: Name the choice made.
terms.first_use_explanation: An entity that offers a set list of options.
terms.avoid_confusion: It is not a Dropdown helper. Keep option values exact.

terms.household_wording: Name the quantity reported.

provenance.rights_boundary: Upstream source material retains its own licence. Do not describe extracted native labels, official writing guides or source artwork as original MIT-licensed civica content.

native_values_coverage.coverage: Every name, state label, named attribute and attribute-value label in entity_component for the fetched strings files of the 45 registered platforms. Missing translation subtrees are not fabricated.
native_values_coverage.meaning: Context-sensitive label reference, not a claim that all attributes are present on every entity, that every state is physically confirmed, or that every vendor value is enumerated.
native_values_coverage.identifiers: Raw keys and English source labels are preserved; reference tokens are resolved against the pinned Core common strings. Native locale selection remains Home Assistant-owned.

interface_boundary: The independent interface census owns route, row, badge, picture-element, more-info and public-versus-internal coverage. This terminology register covers the enumerated glossary/platform/card/feature/selector/view/Settings/helper vocabularies and links that census rather than claiming every route or label is a new term.

writing_source_review.reason: No change to the 37 hashed writing sources. The current Plain English index and SCULPT framework do not establish a contradiction with the adopted source scopes. A source refresh is not a new compliance pass for all authored content.

sources.review_scope: Current free-guides index and publishing restriction reviewed. Existing four-guide synthesis remains dated 2026-11-11; this refresh does not claim every linked PDF was reread.
Current framework page reviewed: extended mnemonic and attribution/licence boundary agree with the existing chapter. No prior HTML hash was recorded, so unchanged bytes cannot be established.

review_triggers: New supported Core or frontend release
A changed glossary entry or exact native label
Confirmed confusion found in a household task review
procedure: Read the upstream change and determine its scope before updating prose.
Retain stable HT identifiers where the meaning remains the same; record any retired code as historical.
Reconcile every listed inventory denominator with its pinned source.
Check native labels and translation pointers without rewriting translations or user names.
Review examples and cross-links, then run the documentation and rendered interaction checks.
Record source review separately from browser, user and live-device evidence.

exclusions: No invented translations or global search-and-replace of native wording.
No complete inventory of vendor-specific states, custom integrations, custom cards, action parameters or future releases.
No claim that a native dispatch key is a documented public API or that every native feature is adapted by civica.
No new installation, device control, safety assurance, accessibility certificate or live-household verification.
